==May 16, 2026 "Update Executive"==
===New Sections===
* Added [[Unnamed Sector]] and [[Section E]]

===Section Changes===
====[[Section A]]====
* Few small tweaks
* New rooms
* [[A-20]] tutorial room now randomly spawns
* [[A-60]] no longer spawns [[A-60i]] if shot
* [[A-85]] has a karma mechanic
* Added [[A-120]]
* Redesigned and changed [[A-135]] a bit

====[[Section D]]====
* Few new rooms between both Depth and Derelict
* [[D-5]] tutorial room now randomly spawns
* "Doctors Lab" has been re-added as an ambience to endless more Derelict
* Added [[D-55i]], [[D-175]], and [[D-250]]
* New soundtrack and a few tweaks to [[D-60i]]
* [[D-200]] boss has been added
* [[D-5i]] can now be outraged
* [[D-120]] can now be shot
* [[D-140]] can now be shot to delay him from rushing by a bit

====[[Section M]]====
* Overhauled the entire sections room design
* Removed the I Section lighting system
* Added 2 new subsections. Flooded rooms can now be found in endless mode, and Mini change can be found in both endless mode and from M-300 to M-380 for the upcoming boss fight, and might show up again some time later
* Small tweaks to error doors
* Added [[M-22i]]
* [[M-60]] can now check multiple lockers
* [[M-120]] when mimicking [[D-20]] can now be "killed"
* [[M-150]] now moves faster
* [[M-200]] has a unique design when it has been shot enough
* [[M-60i]] has received not only a redesign but an entire visual overhaul
* Redesigned [[M-70]], [[M-120]], and [[M-200]]

====Misc Entities====
* New design for [[Void]] and V-90 hit effect

====Global Entity Changes====
* [[Red Rooms]] timer entities will stop breaking doors if progression isn't made
* Locker checker entities will now pathfind to lockers when they are about to check them, making it so they no longer clip through walls
* New... entities? Or not entities, have been spotted past room 1200 in any section

===Other Things===
* Few new items have been added
* The "Color Module" gamepass has been added
* After room 5000 in every section, the lights will begin to flicker off and never turn back on
* Good number of new [[Modifiers]], ranging from giving you more speed or regeneration to putting you on a time limit throughout the rooms or making ever bit of damage turn into malicious damage
* Some [[Modifiers]] are now locked behind badges
* [[Modifiers]] that give positive effects now disable progress from being given
* World Records have been reset back down to 1000 in every section

==June 4, 2026==
===Post-Executive Patch 1===
====[[Section A]] Changes====
* [[A-120]] should rebound less on average
* ([[Modifiers|II Hate This]]) [[A-20ii]] changes the appearance of the locker it breaks.
* New rooms
====[[Section D]] changes====
* [[D-175]] has been fixed and added to the game
* Lights in Derelict past D-500 should be fixed
* ([[Modifiers|II Hate This]]) [[D-55ii]] now has a fire trail. Suffer.
====[[Section M]] changes====
* [[M-70]] has a new kill sound and a got a few fixes
* [[M-120]]'s main form DPS has been buffed and has gained a DPS locker snipe
* [[M-150]] will always be blue if [[M-22]] ([[Red Rooms]] only), [[M-60]], [[M-120]] are active, or if there are broken blue lockers up to 2 rooms back.
* [[M-134]], [[M-200]] and [[Mouth]] can no longer spawn in flooded rooms
* [[M-22i]] will not break the door if [[M-70]] is active.
====[[Unnamed Sector]] changes====
* [[Mori]] should now be the most common entity. [[Mori]] variants and alt variants have cooldowns, which decrease in value each [[Mori]] spawn.
* Nerfed [[False-60]]. He only rebounds if you're past door 75, his earliest special mechanic can be triggered past room 400, and his infamous camping mechanic only happens past room 500.
* Nerfed V-Booster and AD-STR's spawn weight.
* [[False-200]]'s pathfinding should no longer break at times.
* [[False-120]] cant have any other entities spawn when initially flickering the lights outside of [[Red Rooms]]
* [[False-200]] and [[Execution]] can no longer spawn on the same door
** In return, [[Execution]] will wait less time before attacking in [[Red Rooms]]
* [[Mouth|False-300]]'s chase has a better ending and chase music is no longer listed as music in the game files so it can't be muted
* Keycard in the [[Unnamed Sector]] gets more common the further you go
* Removed a few items from the [[Unnamed Sector]] item pool, essentially making the keycard more common from the start
====[[Section E]] changes====
* [[E-30i]] now rebounds back when breaking a door and has static
* Final anti-softlock updates for [[E-90]], hopefully.
* Nerfed [[E-120]], he only checks lockers if a player starts hiding near him instead of checking anyone who was already hiding too close to him
* Nerfed [[E-200]]'s kill radius from 42 to 36 studs.
* Gave [[E-90]] and [[E-245]] timers in [[Red Rooms]].
* Fixed the E-1000 badge not being awarded
* Nerfed [[E-10i]], no longer annoying in [[Red Rooms]]
* Disabled [[E-245]] dodge roll mechanic in red rooms
* [[E-245]] bugfixes
====Miscellaneous Changes====
* [[Void|V-90]]'s movement detection system changes when you're swimming now to specifically to accommodate for flooded rooms
* Updated swimming system a bit, should no longer force you to go up and makes swimming overall a lot better (hopefully)
-
* Fixed the [[Unnamed Sector]] Banning the player upon entering, and hopefully unbanned everyone affected.
